ESSAY 008 · 6 MIN READ

A quieter way to read

Good design gives ideas room to breathe. A thoughtful translation should preserve the rhythm of a page, not just its words.

Read the design principles and follow a sentence across languages. Links should remain useful, and the original should always be close at hand.

Understanding begins when we slow down enough to notice.

Details make the difference

  • Keep a paragraph together, even when it contains emphasis or a link.
  • Respect the structure of a list.
    • A nested idea deserves its own space.
  • Leave code and private input untouched.

Use reader.restore() to return to the original view.

ElementReading experience
Links and emphasisMeaning and hierarchy stay connected.
Tables and listsThe page keeps its original structure.

reader.restore(); // this code stays unchanged
